A man riding a Red Koopa Troopa slowly enters the screen from the right.

text: After receiving the pizza, Cleopatra agrees to take Mike to the tetrad.

evidence.quote: Let me take you to the tetrad, OK?

evidence.quote: Meet me at the museum at the stroke of midnight.

evidence.quote: A little late to be going to the museum, isn't it?

evidence.quote: Don't even try to get out.

evidence.quote: When you walk up to a cactus...That way you won't get pricked by the needles.
